commands.name: Unlimited health
commands.description: Refills health while Hat Kid is alive.

commands.name: Jump height multiplier
commands.description: Scales the base jump height setting.

commands.name: Game speed multiplier
commands.description: Scales the speed of the current world.

commands.name: Enemy stealth
commands.description: Makes Hat Kid invisible to enemies that use the standard AI detection.

commands.name: One-hit kills
commands.description: Reduces the health of standard enemies in the current level to one.

commands.name: Damage multiplier
commands.description: Multiplies the damage of the equipped weapon from 1× to 10×.

commands.name: Add Pons
commands.description: Adds up to 1,000,000 Pons to the active save balance.

commands.name: Add yarn
commands.description: Adds up to 1,000,000 yarn to the active save balance.

commands.name: Track collectibles
commands.description: Shows the direction and distance to the nearest loaded collectible.

commands.name: Track Time Rifts
commands.description: Shows the direction and distance to the nearest visible Time Rift in the current level.

commands.name: God mode
commands.description: Blocks hits, hard landings and automatic return after falling out of the level in solo play.

commands.name: Teleport to nearest collectible
commands.description: Moves once to the nearest visible collectible in the current level. Turn off and on to use again.

commands.name: No-clip
commands.description: Fly through walls in solo play. Hold Space to ascend or Ctrl to descend. Disable in an open area.
